# Draft:Filmfare Award Best Costume Design – South

The Filmfare Award Best Costume Design - South is given by the Filmfare magazine as part of its annual Filmfare Awards South for South Indian films.
The award was first given in 2010. Here is a list of the award winners and the films for which they won.
